name: multi-asset-borrow
description: 8,000 XLM plus 2,000 BTC units priced at 0.5 against 7,000 USDC. The collateral value is 8,000 + 1,000 = 9,000, so the weighted amount is 7,200 and the health factor is 1.03x. The break-even is no longer a single asset's price: it is the weighted combination, which is exactly what a single-asset liquidation price cannot express.
